summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Ltd. announced on Form 6-K the appointment of Louis Ho Ming Leung as CFO effective June 8, 2026. Mr. Leung, a Hong Kong CPA with over 10 years of experience, will oversee financial strategy, accounting, financing and auditing. This is a routine appointment, not a forced departure or sudden change. No terms, premiums, or advisors are involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a management appointment. What to watch: any subsequent disclosure of a change in financial strategy or material transactions.
